Source notes (added 2026-08-12): Attached 1910 & 1920 US censuses (Chicago Ward 7 / Ward 3, Cook Co., IL), Illinois Deaths & Stillbirths Index 1916-1947, and Find A Grave (burial Gurnee, Lake Co., IL). Conflicts to watch: birth year recorded as 1859 in 1910 census and abt 1858 in 1920, vs tree date 26 Jun 1858 Granby, Quebec — kept tree date. Immigration/arrival year is 1885 in 1910 census but 1886 in 1920 census; only 1886 attached, 1885 noted here rather than added as a competing fact.

Hand chart 13 Aug 2026: George Slack Wood m. Mary Wagner Bentley 1888 NY, NY. Son Norman Bentley Wood m. Mae Chill 1916 Chicago. Daughter Marjorie -> Konecny. (Note: tree carries sourced marriage 02 Oct 1889, Grace Church Brooklyn NY; chart's 1888 left as unresolved conflict, not overwritten.)

14 Aug 2026 Wood-line (Jabez / Henry not in this tree as people): Path B (Allerton/Priest/Barker) is NOT a blood Mayflower line. Mary Barker married two Priest grandsons then David2 Wood; Jabez3 is the third-marriage child. Only Path A Howland x Tilley via Hannah Nelson is a blood claim. Do not put Priest/Allerton on the Wood line.

Henry Wood x Abigail Jenney marriage is 28 Apr 1644 (PCR 2:79), not the chart's 1645. Henry is not a Mayflower passenger.

14 Aug 2026: Marriage to Mary W. Bentley corrected from 1889 to 2 Oct 1888, Grace Church Brooklyn; Kings Co. cert 3749 (Daily Standard Union 4 Oct 1888; ItalianGen/NYC Open Data cert 3749). Hand chart 1888 was right; tree 1889 was wrong.

N0056.html:
Hand chart 13 Aug 2026: chart gives this couple as Samuel Wood x Abigail PHILBRICK; tree currently has Abigail Church (1788-1837), m. 1809, and their son Alonzo CHURCH Wood supports "Church" as the maiden name. Conflict recorded only - nothing overwritten. Needs a record source (Vermont/Quebec marriage 1809) to settle Philbrick vs Church.

14 Aug 2026: Chart wife "Abigail Philbrick" is BROKEN. AssNat / Dict. des parlementaires du Quebec: Samuel Wood m. Brattleboro 3 Dec 1809 Abigail Church, dau. Reuben Church x Elizabeth Whipple. Compiled only, no town register pulled. Do not lock Church or Philbrick.

REJECTED chart wife “Abigail Philbrick.” Published wife is Abigail Church (already on tree as 212735895871), m. Brattleboro 3 Dec 1809, dau. Reuben Church × Elizabeth Whipple — AssNat notice Samuel Wood (1787–1848), https://www.assnat.qc.ca/en/deputes/wood-samuel-5761/biographie.html (July 2009); Allaire & Johnson, Dict. des parlementaires du Qubec 1792–1992 (PUL, 1993), p. 780. Chart Philbrick is a mix-up with a different Maine Wood (Charles Franklin Wood m. a Philbrick 1868; WOOD-SOURCES §5). Do not create Philbrick. Do not replace Church. Do not lock 1809 as a town VR until Brattleboro register pulled.

21 Oct 2026: Named as son in father Phillip Wood's will (dated 29 Mar 1842, proved 25 Aug 1845, Marlboro District Vol 17-18 pp.101-102). Will gives no residence for Samuel: parent link STRONG, not SOLID.

N0130.html:
Hand chart 13 Aug 2026: chart names Philip Wood's wife as Eunice PIQUEE, m. 1781. Tree/other sources render the surname as PIERCE (Eunice Pierce appears as Samuel Wood's potential mother, not currently attached as Philip's spouse here). Conflict noted only - Pierce NOT overwritten and Piquee NOT entered as fact. "Piquee" may be a phonetic/Huguenot spelling (Piquet/Pequee) or a misreading of Pierce; needs a 1781 marriage record before either form is adopted. Also unresolved: no spouse is currently linked to Philip in this tree.

MAYFLOWER CLAIMS (recorded here because Jabez Wood and Hannah Nelson are NOT in this tree - Jabez appears only as an unaccepted member-tree hint above Philip): chart claims two Mayflower paths - (1) Howland-Tilley via Hope Huckins, (2) Allerton-Priest via Mary Barker. Henry Wood is NOT a Mayflower passenger. Chart cites "Mayflower Quarterly Feb '98 p.67"; the actual 1998 article is Alicia Crane Williams in Mayflower Descendant 48:13-20. Maiden name of the relevant Mary (Combs / Cuthbertson / Barker) is left OPEN/unlocked pending evidence.

14 Aug 2026: Man is real (Cabot, Annals of Brattleboro 1:159: b. Rehoboth 29 Apr 1756 compiled, d. Brattleboro 16 Jul 1845). Parentage as son of Jabez Jr x Joanna Short is WEAK. Published children of that couple list Joanna, not Philip. Leave Jabez/Joanna as Potential.

14 Aug 2026: PARENTS ACCEPTED (locked). Marlboro Dist. (Windham) Probate vol. 1 p. 316, will 25 Feb 1793, Ancestry collection 9084 image 192. Testator Jabez Wood of Brattleboro names "well Beloved Son Phillip Wood." Wife Rachel (2nd, Bullock 1776). Philip is of first wife Joanna Short (Warren 7 Apr 1748). 1756 Rehoboth birth still compiled. Do not merge with son Jabez.

N0160.html: Added 13 Aug 2026 from the 1893 baptism of grandson Petr Pavel Konecny, Acta Publica / MZA Brno, matrika book 4021 (Brumov na Vlare), snimek 151: the child's father Jan Konecny, nadennik in Sv. Stepan, is named as "son of Jan Konecny, servant at the manor court (pansky dvur) in Hluk, and Frantiska, daughter of Frantisek Sebak, cottager of Hluk." No birth or death dates are given in that entry, so none are recorded here. 14 Aug 2026: parents added from Stitna book 4740 s.18 (2 Jun 1868 marriage of son Jan): "syn po Pavlovi Konečným, zemřelém služebném v panském dvoře ve Vlachovicích a jeho manželky Mariny Trchel z Lidečka." Their own birth/marriage/death pages not in hand; no dates entered.

2026-08-13: MZA Brno Acta Publica book 4725 (Štítná N 1787-1856) snímek 100, fol. 196, house 137. Born 1 Dec 1834 as Franziska, marked unehelich; father Franz Sscheback/Šebák, legitimized per subsequens matrimonium (cross-ref Copulationum fol. 169). Mother Marina, daughter of Anton Miklas. Matches 1868 marriage book 4740 s.18 (age 33y 6m).

2026-08-13 night: WEDDING STILL OPEN. Do not lock František Šebák × Marina Miklas as 6 Feb 1837 book 4739 fol.69 — second read is other couples (Hubník × Holba etc.). The Franz + Marina Miklas crop is a birth/paternity note, not the wedding. Birth-page citation points to Copulationum fol. 169 / Fol. 66; neither found in book 4739. Neighbor-parish hunt running overnight.

N0169.html:
Death 28 Feb 1936 established from Find a Grave (Evergreen Cemetery, Manitowoc, WI; spou se Anna) plus a 26 Feb 1936 Two Rivers Reporter item "Peter Konecny of Manitowoc Dead" (Wisconsin Newspapers.com Stories & Events Index) — both attached. Exact death place not yet confirmed by a certificate; Wisconsin's pre-1959 death index is not on Ancestry, so a certified death record should be ordered from Wisconsin Vital Records / Manitowoc County. Naturalization: cert. F-855, Circuit Court, Manitowoc Co. Birthplace Hovorany, Hodonín, Moravia per 1912 Galveston manifest.

13 Aug 2026 IDENTITY / BIRTHPLACE CORRECTION: The Galveston 8 Dec 1912 S.S. Rhein Petr Konečný from Hovorany (uncle Josef, miner, destination Texas) is a DIFFERENT man. Our Peter is the NY 20 Aug 1913 S.S. Kaiser Wilhelm II arrival: Petr Konečný, 19, glazier, destination Milwaukee; mother Veronika Konečny of Kosťany, Bohemia; father Jan already in US. 1920/1930 censuses give immigration year 1913. Hovorany/Hodonín should not be used as birthplace for citizenship filing. SOA Litoměřice Košťany (Teplice) N 1889–1897 sign. 76/2 was read for June 1893 — no Petr Konečný / no Jan+Veronika. Next: Teplice-area neighbor parishes and other Bohemian Košťany. Do not order MZA Brno Hovorany extract for this person.

13 Aug 2026 PETITION 855 / NATURALIZATION PAPERS (FamilySearch, Wisconsin naturalization records vol. 5, images img569-img571; all three images uploaded to this profile's gallery): Declaration of Intention no. 10633, Circuit Court Milwaukee Co., Wis., 14 Aug 1915 - Peter Konecny, age 22, glass blower, residence 722 14th St., Milwaukee; arrived New York 20 Aug 1913 on the Kaiser Wilhelm II; last foreign residence given as TEPLITZ (Teplice), Bohemia. Petition for Naturalization no. 855, Circuit Court Manitowoc Co., Wis., filed 28 Dec 1921 - occupation welder, residence N. 20th St., Manitowoc; wife Annie born 15 Oct 1892 Austria (tree currently shows 15 Sep 1891 Bohemia - conflict flagged, tree date NOT overwritten); one child listed: Joseph, born 1 Dec 1921 Manitowoc. Naturalized 6 Jun 1922, cert. F-855. NOTES: (1) The papers name Teplitz only as the LAST RESIDENCE before emigration - the birth VILLAGE is still unidentified and the birthplace field has deliberately NOT been changed to Teplice. (2) Hovorany is the WRONG man - the Galveston 1912 S.S. Rhein Petr Konecny from Hovorany is a different person, as noted above. (3) Joseph b. 1 Dec 1921 Manitowoc is NOT added as a profile this pass, pending confirmation (Frank b. 1924 is the child already in the tree).

13 Aug 2026 PARISH HUNT (off-Ancestry, not Ancestry collections): Hovorany RC birth book, MZA Brno sign. 5342 (1874-1919), READ for June 1893: NO Petr Konecny; surname absent from the index entirely. The Galveston 1912 Hovorany man is therefore a different Petr. SOA Litomerice, Kostany N 1889-1897 sign. 76/2, READ for June 1893: no Petr Konecny. Also READ and NEGATIVE for June 1893 (Catholic): Strelna 76/3; Jenikov 67/16; Hrob 53/9; Krupka 83/27; Dubi 128/37; Bohosudov 10/12; Kostomlaty 75/8; Duchcov 36/14 and 36/15 K-index; Teplice deanery index 162/M K 1893; Osek 131/B K 1893; Frycovice/Fritschowitz church books (FamilySearch) June 1893 - the Otilie b. 2 Jul 1893 there is to Ludvik x Veronika Sugar, NOT our family. Corroborating: 1913 New York manifest gives mother Veronika, Kostany, Bohemia; Declaration of Intention gives last residence Teplitz. CONCLUSION: birth village still unidentified; 28 Jun 1893 Hovorany birthplace remains unproven and no parish register entry has been located to date.

N0174.html:
Research note (added 2026-08-12): Added Cook County, Illinois Marriage Index 1912-1942 (Anna Tauber m. Peter J Konecny, 22 Feb 1919, Cook Co., IL) and 1950 US Census (Manitowoc, Manitowoc Co., WI). Name/birth conflicts: indexed as "Anna Konecny", birth abt 1893 Czechoslovakia in 1950 census vs tree 15 Sep 1891 Bohemia — tree date kept. Family lore says nine Tauber siblings emigrated; only Antonie (1875), Francisca (1883) and Bozena are currently in the tree, and Antonie has no record hints at all. Additional siblings should be added only from official records (passenger lists, censuses, naturalizations), not from member trees.

13 Aug 2026 PETITION 855 BIRTH-DATE CONFLICT: Peter Konecny's Petition for Naturalization no. 855, Circuit Court Manitowoc Co., Wis., filed 28 Dec 1921 (FamilySearch, Wisconsin naturalization records vol. 5, img571 - image uploaded to Peter Konecny's gallery) names his wife as Annie, born 15 Oct 1892 in Austria, and lists one child, Joseph, born 1 Dec 1921 Manitowoc. The tree currently shows her birth as 15 Sep 1891 Bohemia. Conflict flagged only - the tree date has NOT been overwritten pending further evidence (birth/baptismal record needed).

13 Aug 2026 GIVEN NAME: Formal given name Anna (Peter's Petition 855: "Anna, b. 15 Oct 1892, Austria"). Everyday/US name Annie (headstone, death records). Same person. Birth-date conflict left unlocked until certified Cook/WI records.

N0178.html:
Research note (added 2026-08-12): Birthplace recorded here as "Bohemia" 1859, but his children's events point to Moravia — son Peter b. 28 Jun 1893 Hovorany, Hodonin district, Jihomoravsky (South Moravian) region; son Joseph b. 1901 in Czech lands. Bohemia vs Moravia conflict left unresolved; keeping existing tree value rather than overwriting from unsourced member trees. Only hint currently available is a member family tree (Backus Family Tree), not accepted — needs official records (parish/church books for Hovorany, Milwaukee death record, naturalization) before changing birthplace or adding parents John Konecny/Mary Nedbal with confidence. Also confirm death place "Milwaukee, WI" with an official death index entry.

13 Aug 2026 UPDATE (Acta Publica, MZA Brno, book 4021, https://www.mza.cz/actapublica/matrika/detail/300): Son "Petr Pavel" Konecny born 28 Jun 1893, house 160, Svaty Stepan (osada of Bylnice), parish Brumov na Vlare (snimek 151); father listed as Jan Konecny, nadennik ve Sv. Stepani, son of Jan Konecny (servant, pansky dvur Hluk) and Frantiska (dau. of Frantisek Sebak, cottager of Hluk); mother Veronika, dau. of Jiri Kadlec (nadennik ve Sv. Stepani) and Marie (dau. of Jiri Kostka, pasekar ve Sv. Stepani). Second son Frantisek b. 20 Aug 1895, same house 160 (snimek 165), father then pomocnik v huti. So the family was in MORAVIA (Brumov-Bylnice), not Hovorany; Kostany/Teplitz were later glass-work residence. Hovorany Peter is a different man. Diacritics omitted due to input limits. 13 Aug 2026 CLEANUP: birth changed 1859 -> abt 1867, Svaty Stepan/Bylnice, Moravia (age 46 on 14 May 1913 Kaiser Wilhelm der Grosse). Mary Nedbal UNLINKED as mother and the old John Konecny UNLINKED as father (leftover from wrong-man detour; both persons kept in tree, not merged). Parents now taken from son Petr Pavel's 1893 baptism, MZA Brno book 4021 snimek 151: father Jan Konecny, servant at the manor court (pansky dvur) in Hluk; mother Frantiska, daughter of Frantisek Sebak, cottager of Hluk. No birth years

invented for them.

13 Aug 2026 GIVEN NAME: Parish and 1913 manifest use Jan. US records use John.

14 Aug 2026 research note (overnight negatives; do not hunt these MZA books again):
- His father Jan ~Dec 1832 is NOT in Stitna 4725, Vlachovice 4946, Brumov 4014, Valasske Klobouky 4822.
- Pavel Konecny x Marina Trchel marriage is NOT in Vlachovice 4959, Brumov 4024, or Valasske Klobouky 4846.
- Next book is Lidecko (ZA Opava), parked (bot wall).

Research note (2026-08-12): Hint offered "Veronaca Bryztoushu" in NY County Marriage Records, 1847-1849/1907-1936 — marriage 17 Jun 1933, Tompkins Co., NY, spouse John Konecny. NOT accepted: date is far too late for this Veronia (son Peter b. 1893 in Hovorany, Bohemia; family in Kostany/Manitowoc), so this is likely a different, younger couple or a much later remarriage that needs proof. Surname "Bryztoushu" is worth checking as a possible maiden-name variant (Brystoush/Brzystousek?) but no confirming evidence yet. Second hint is a member tree (Cotterill-Riley) — not used per official-sources-only policy.

Stepani) and Marie (dau. of Jiri Kostka, pasekar ve Sv. Stepani) - so maiden name KADLEC, from Svaty Stepan, Moravia. Father Jan Konecny, nadennik. N0182.html:
IDENTITY / SOURCING NOTE (2026-08-12, C. Konecny):
Sourced this Frank Konecny (b. 20 Aug 1895, Czechoslovakia/Moravia; d. 4 Jun 1976, Manitowoc Co., WI) with official records only:
- 1920, 1930, 1940, 1950 US Federal Census (Manitowoc WI; 1930 Milwaukee)
- SSDI (b. 20 Aug 1895, d. Jun 1976, WI)
- WWII Draft Registration Card 1942 (Manitowoc WI, b. 20 Aug 1895 Czechoslovakia)
- Find a Grave index (burial Manitowoc, WI)
Identity basis: exact 20 Aug 1895 DOB match across SSDI, draft card and grave; Czech/Moravian birth; immigration 1912/1913 matching half-brother Peter Konecny's 1912 Galveston arrival; consistent Manitowoc/Milwaukee WI residence, i.e. the same John Konecny line. Wife Lillian (Wacek) and later Lydia; children Edward, John, Louis - NOT added as new profiles.
CAUTION: Unrelated Chicago/Cook County Konecnys exist; no Cook County records were attached here. Member trees, member photos, and obituary-index-only items were left unattached pending stronger evidence.

2026-08-13 (C. Konecny): Parish book 4021 snímek 165 — František Konečný b. 20 Aug 1895, bapt. 25 Aug 1895, house 160 Svatý Štěpán; parents Jan Konečný and Veronika Kadlec (same marriage as brother Petr Pavel 1893). Traveled on his father Jan's 14 May 1913 ship Kaiser Wilhelm der Grosse as Frantisek ~1895. Likely the Frank Konecny, welder, Rankin St, who witnessed Peter's Petition 855. Mother Veronia Kadlec linked on this date; he is a full brother of Peter, not a half-brother. Name note: baptized František (book 4021, 20 Aug 1895, house 160). US records use Frank.

IDENTITY / SOURCING NOTE (2026-08-12, C. Konecny):
Sourced this Joseph Konecny (b. 17 Feb 1901 Zuorovy/Czechoslovakia; d. Apr 1985, WI) with official records only:
- 1930, 1940, 1950 US Federal Census (Milwaukee, WI)
- SSDI: "Joseph Sr. Konecny", b. 17 Feb 1901, d. Apr 1985, WI residence before 1951
- WWII Draft Card 1940-1947 (Milwaukee WI, b. 17 Feb 1901 Bohemia)
- Naturalization Record Index: naturalized 15 Feb 1940, b. 17 Feb 1901 Czechoslovakia, resident Wisconsin
Identity basis: exact 17 Feb 1901 DOB across SSDI, draft card and naturalization; Czech/Bohemian birth; arrival 1913 matching this John Konecny family's immigration; Milwaukee/Manitowoc WI residence alongside half-brothers Peter and Frank.
NOT attached: Wisconsin marriage record to Agnes Masar (26 Jun 1924, Milwaukee) and SSAC index - both would have required creating a new spouse/child profile; obituary index and member trees also left unattached. Marriage is very likely correct; attach later if new-person creation is permitted.
CAUTION: Unrelated Chicago/Cook County Konecnys exist; no Cook County records attached here.

2026-08-13 (C. Konecny): Mother Veronia Kadlec linked on this date. Joseph (b. 17 Feb 1901) is a child of Jan/*John Konecny × Veronika Kadlec — the same marriage that produced Peter (1893), Frank (1895) and Mary (1903); not a second family. 1920 census, Manitowoc Ward 4, shows widow Veronika with Joseph ~19 and Mary ~16. Full brother, not half-brother.

IDENTITY / SOURCING NOTE (2026-08-12, C. Konecny):
Sourced this *Mary Konecny / Mary (Konecny) Hejnal (b. 16 Oct 1903, Czechoslovakia; d. 25 Apr 1989, Milwaukee Co., WI) with official records only:
- 1920 US Census, Manitowoc Ward 4, WI (age 17, daughter, laborer) - enumerated with brother Joseph, the key link to this John Konecny family
- 1930, 1940, 1950 US Federal Census, Milwaukee, WI (as Mary Hejnal/Hejnarl; arrival 1914)
- SSDI: b. 16 Oct 1903, d. Apr 1989, WI residence before 1951
- Wisconsin Death Index 1959-1997: d. 25 Apr 1989, Milwaukee, cert. 202278
- Find a Grave index: burial Holy Cross Cemetery, Milwaukee, WI (stone reads Nov 16 1903 - April 25 1989)
- US Naturalization Record Indexes: naturalized 15 Feb 1940, b. 16 Oct 1903 Czechoslovakia, resident Wisconsin - same 15 Feb 1940 Milwaukee naturalization date as half-brother Joseph Konecny
Identity basis: 16 Oct 1903 DOB consistent across SSDI, naturalization and grave; Czech birth; 1920 Manitowoc household with sibling Joseph; Milwaukee residence alongside half-brothers Peter, Frank and Joseph; shared 1940 naturalization date with Joseph.
NOT attached: husband James Hejnal and children (Frank, James Jr, Joseph , Rosemary, Joseph Michael) - would have required creating NEW person profiles; also left unattached: Wisconsin Death Records 1872-2004 spouse/child index entry, SSAC index, and member trees.
CAUTION: Unrelated Chicago/Cook County Konecnys exist; no Cook County records were attached here.

2026-08-13 (C. Konecny): Mother Veronia Kadlec linked on this date. Mary (b. 16 Oct 1903, later Mary Konecny Hejnal) is a child of Jan/*John Konecny Veronika Kadlec — the same marriage as Peter (1893), Frank (1895) and Joseph (1901); not a second family. 1920 census, Manitowoc Ward 4, widow Veronika with Joseph ~19 and Mary ~16. Full sister, not half-sister.

N0188.html: Research note (12 Aug 2026): No Ancestry records located for Jan Tauber or wife Anna Kralova. Family research points to Mostiste (Mostiště), Moravia/Bohemia as the family's origin - daughters Antonie (1875), Francisca (1883), Bozena and Annie (1891, later Konecny of Manitowoc/Two Rivers WI) are recorded there. The Mostiste/Moravia origin is research-side (family reunion book and secondary research) and is NOT yet supported by any record in Ancestry; Czech parish registers would need to be checked directly. No parents added for Jan.

N0205.html: Research note (12 Aug 2026): No Ancestry record hints on this profile. Targeted searches run for Francisca/Frantiska/Franziska/Frances Tauber b. ~1883 Bohemia, incl. Manitowoc/Wisconsin residence filter: nothing that ties clearly to Jan Tauber & Anna Kralova of Mostiste or to sister Annie Tauber Konecny (Two Rivers, WI). Hits found were other Tauber families (Chicago/Illinois, Iowa, Oneida Co. WI) - not attached. Next steps: find Annie's immigration/naturalization and 1900-1920 census households to see whether Francisca emigrated at all; also check Czech (Moravia, Mostiste/Velke Mezirici) parish registers, which are not indexed on Ancestry.

William Gust Chill b. 1 Nov 1899 Chicago (WWI draft 6482/776980; WWII Young Men 2238/40254388) — residence WWII 2249 W. Cullerton St. = renamed 2249 W. 20th (Albert×Tillie house 1910/1920). 1900 Willie in Albert×Tillie HH; 1974 Herald sibling bridge with Mae Wood. Synod bapt + Cook 2545 birth parents MISS. Nearest relative WWI = wife Ethel Chill (not parents named). Parents attached via census + address bridge + Herald — not via bapt. Prefer Bieging. Do not lock birth onto Mae.

William Chill × Ethel Jensch m. 20 Jan 1917 Lake Co. Indiana — Ancestry 5059/1492557; 60282/3644925–3644926; 61009/94642009 (Book 29 p.317 / FHL 002414694). Cook Chill×Ethel MISS (married IN). WWI draft nearest relative Ethel Chill @ 2110 W. 21st Pl.; 1920 SIL of Otto×W Bertha Jensch. 1974 Herald widow Marie A. Chase Chill is later wife (FL m. 9 Aug 1972) — not Ethel.

N0770.html: Transcription (as written): Two Rivers, WI - Fredrick Alan Matchopatow, 70, passed away after a long, hard fought battle with chronic illnesses. His wife of 34 years, Sandra, died on May 20th. Those close to him felt that this loss added a broken heart and loneliness to Fred. Fred, surrounded by loving family and friends, died on June 24, 2018. The son of William and Mary Matchopatow was born August 14, 1947 in Shawano, Wisconsin. Fred graduated from Shawano High School and Lakeshore Technical Institute. Fred and Sandy (Konecny) were married on July 14, 1984 and they spent their life together in Two Rivers, Wisconsin. Fred was employed for over 40 years at the Anheuser-Busch malt plant in Manitowoc retiring in 2012. ... Survivors include his brothers-in-law Peter (Jody) Konecny and Michael (Nancy) Konecny. He is also survived by many nephews, nieces and many loving friends. ... Fred was preceded in death by his parents and two sisters. Friends may call at Deja & Martin Funeral Chapels, 1506 18th St., Two Rivers from 5:30-7:00 p.m. on Thursday, June 28, 2018. The Funeral Service will be celebrated at 7:00 p.m. at the funeral chapel.

N0819.html: Transcription (as written): Two Rivers, WI - Fredrick Alan Matchopatow, 70, passed away after a long, hard fought battle with chronic illnesses. His wife of 34 years, Sandra, died on May 20th. Those close to him felt that this loss added a broken heart and loneliness to Fred. Fred, surrounded by loving family and friends, died on June 24, 2018. The son of William and Mary Matchopatow was born August 14, 1947 in Shawano, Wisconsin. Fred graduated from Shawano High School and Lakeshore Technical Institute. Fred and Sandy (Konecny) were married on July 14, 1984 and they spent their life together in Two Rivers, Wisconsin. Fred was employed for over 40 years at the Anheuser-Busch malt plant in Manitowoc retiring in 2012. ... Survivors include his brothers-in-law Peter (Jody) Konecny and Michael (Nancy) Konecny. He is also survived by many nephews, nieces and many loving friends. ... Fred was preceded in death by his parents and two sisters. Friends may call at Deja & Martin Funeral Chapels, 1506 18th St., Two Rivers from 5:30-7:00 p.m. on Thursday, June 28, 2018. The Funeral Service will be celebrated at 7:00 p.m. at the funeral chapel.
